title: Echo in the Fallout Theater
description: A woman in a grey jumpsuit sits in a worn theater chair inside a derelict bunker, holding a film reel while glowing with purple energy as she watches a cracked projection screen showing a man with a shocked expression. The concrete room is filled with hanging film strips, old movie posters including one for 'Eich', a clapperboard, and tangled film reels on the floor under a single spotlight.
